mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fee_record (register_id, item_type, item_id, fee_type, fee_amount, fee_method, refund_target_id, operator_id, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{registerId}, #{itemType}, #{itemId}, #{feeType}, #{feeAmount}, #{feeMethod}, #{refundTargetId}, #{operatorId}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fee_record WHERE register_id = #{registerId} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT fr.id, fr.register_id, r.case_number, r.real_name, r.gender, r.age, r.card_number, fr.item_type, fr.item_id, fr.fee_type, fr.fee_amount, fr.fee_method, fr.refund_target_id, fr.remark, fr.create_time, COALESCE(d.drug_name, mt.tech_name, lv.regist_name) AS item_name, COALESCE(d.drug_format, mt.tech_format) AS item_format, COALESCE(p.unit_price, d.drug_price, mt.tech_price, lv.regist_fee) AS unit_price, COALESCE(p.drug_number, '1') AS quantity, COALESCE(p.drug_state, cr.check_state, ir.inspection_state, dr.disposal_state) AS item_state, dep.dept_name AS dept_name FROM fee_record fr JOIN register r ON fr.register_id = r.id LEFT JOIN prescription p ON fr.item_type = '处方' AND fr.item_id = p.id LEFT JOIN drug_info d ON p.drug_id = d.id LEFT JOIN check_request cr ON fr.item_type = '检查' AND fr.item_id = cr.id LEFT JOIN inspection_request ir ON fr.item_type = '检验' AND fr.item_id = ir.id LEFT JOIN disposal_request dr ON fr.item_type = '处置' AND fr.item_id = dr.id LEFT JOIN medical_technology mt ON mt.id = COALESCE(cr.medical_technology_id, ir.medical_technology_id, dr.medical_technology_id) LEFT JOIN department dep ON dep.id = mt.department_id LEFT JOIN regist_level lv ON fr.item_type = '挂号费' AND lv.id = r.regist_level_id WHERE r.case_number = #{caseNumber} ORDER BY fr.id DESC

SELECT fr.id, fr.register_id, r.case_number, r.real_name, r.gender, r.age, r.card_number, fr.item_type, fr.item_id, fr.fee_type, fr.fee_amount, fr.fee_method, fr.refund_target_id, fr.remark, fr.create_time, COALESCE(d.drug_name, mt.tech_name) AS item_name, COALESCE(d.drug_format, mt.tech_format) AS item_format, COALESCE(p.unit_price, d.drug_price, mt.tech_price) AS unit_price, COALESCE(p.drug_number, '1') AS quantity, COALESCE(p.drug_state, cr.check_state, ir.inspection_state, dr.disposal_state) AS item_state, dep.dept_name AS dept_name FROM fee_record fr JOIN register r ON fr.register_id = r.id LEFT JOIN prescription p ON fr.item_type = '处方' AND fr.item_id = p.id LEFT JOIN drug_info d ON p.drug_id = d.id LEFT JOIN check_request cr ON fr.item_type = '检查' AND fr.item_id = cr.id LEFT JOIN inspection_request ir ON fr.item_type = '检验' AND fr.item_id = ir.id LEFT JOIN disposal_request dr ON fr.item_type = '处置' AND fr.item_id = dr.id LEFT JOIN medical_technology mt ON mt.id = COALESCE(cr.medical_technology_id, ir.medical_technology_id, dr.medical_technology_id) LEFT JOIN department dep ON dep.id = mt.department_id WHERE r.case_number = #{caseNumber} AND fr.fee_type = '收费' AND fr.item_type IN ('处方', '检查', '检验', '处置') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fee_record f2 WHERE f2.refund_target_id = fr.id ) ORDER BY fr.id DESC

SELECT CASE #{itemType} WHEN '处方' THEN (SELECT drug_state FROM prescription WHERE id = #{itemId}) WHEN '检查' THEN (SELECT check_state FROM check_request WHERE id = #{itemId}) WHEN '检验' THEN (SELECT inspection_state FROM inspection_request WHERE id = #{itemId}) WHEN '处置' THEN (SELECT disposal_state FROM disposal_request WHERE id = #{itemId}) END
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fee_record WHERE refund_target_id = #{refundTargetId}
